solutions.title: Recursive DFS
solutions.strategy: Use recursive calls around the node visit.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The call stack holds one path of height `h`.

solutions.title: Iterative stack
solutions.strategy: Push left descendants, visit, then move right.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is pushed and popped once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack stores at most one root-to-leaf path.
